label: Bible Study
prompt: For my _____ are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
verse: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
note: God's ways and ours don't run on the same map — and the next verse says how far apart they are.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the LORD that _____ thee.
verse: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the LORD that healeth thee.
note: Just after the bitter waters of Marah turned sweet, God introduces Himself by a new name: the LORD who heals.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in _____ clothes, lying in a manger.
verse: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
note: The angel's sign for the shepherds: a newborn in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me _____, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
verse: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
note: Of twelve spies only Caleb and Joshua said 'we can' — Caleb finally claimed Hebron at eighty-five.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against _____, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
verse: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
note: The real fight isn't flesh and blood but 'principalities' and powers — spiritual-warfare sermons start here.
